title: Saray Inbantak a Manangisumlang na Sipan
intro: Nen inmuna iran agew na sakey a balon komunidad, sakey a tribu so datin manaayam ed saray apadiran ya ayaman, ya akapeket ed sakey a paknaan. Nen asumpal itan a paknaan, saray nansumpalan to et pinmatnag ed saray pahina na Quran. Siopa irayan totoo, tan antoy agawa ed saray kaabungan tan tanamanan da?
clues: Nanayam kami ed saray kuta ya mangiiter ed sikami na palson liknaan na kaligenan.
Sikami so totoo na Kasulatan, balet ta sinumpa mi so sipanan mi.
Nanplano kamin sumpad samay imbaki kayari na insabi tod sikami, balet ag tinmua so getma mi.
Saray palma mi et pinuter lapud ganggan nen Allah, sakey a tanda na pakayari To.
Pinataynan kami ed kaabungan mi, ya ag kami lan balot ompawil, bilang dusa ed impansumlang mi.
Sinalambit itayo na Quran ed kapitulo na pantitipon, tan say istorya tayo et manserbin pasakbay ed saramay manbabalang na paknaan.

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
